CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_booking_rev_of(p_booking_id text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ select coalesce((select rev from public.booking_op_rev where booking_id = p_booking_id), 0)::text $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_booking_op_rev()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare v_id text := case when tg_op = 'DELETE' then old.id else new.id end;
begin
  insert into public.booking_op_rev(booking_id, rev) values (v_id, 1)
  on conflict (booking_id) do update set rev = public.booking_op_rev.rev + 1;
  return null;
end $function$
